description: This file defines the Exception controller class for the OpenCart admin error handling module. It handles displaying an exception error page with breadcrumb navigation and page layout components.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Controller class handling the display of exception error pages in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the exception error page with appropriate breadcrumbs and layout components, injecting the error message details into the view.
